title: Audit Date filter visual depth
description: Audit Date for single-date, date-range, formatting, min/max, calendar UI limits, timezone concerns, comparison mode, and field binding.
objective: Make Date filtering explicit enough for real custom fields instead of a basic text/date input wrapper.
expected_outputs: Timezone and data parsing risk list
acceptance_criteria: The audit identifies whether Date currently filters strings, timestamps, ISO dates, or display text.
The audit covers single date, range, before/after, between, empty state, and reset behavior.
The audit documents native date input styling limits and whether a custom UI is warranted.
The audit ties date behavior to field binding, data type, and compare mode.
verification: Source-backed findings cite resolver, render, CSS, JS, and control IDs.
No Date implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: date audit, resolver, render, frontend runtime

risks: Date filtering can silently fail if formatting and comparison mode are not designed before visual styling.
